integrity.computational_verification: The supplementary verify.py tests finite q,d cases with exact rational arithmetic; it is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact design and exact arithmetic only
No conclusion for weighted, approximate, total-degree or hyperbolic-cross designs
Full text of the relevant Kunis precursor was inaccessible; its abstract and the complete Ehler discussion were compared
The proof is self-contained but has no independent external audit
integrity.scientific_scope: An exact analytic theorem about normalized-arclength tensor-product trigonometric design curves on flat tori. Ehler’s known sharp lower bound and achieving construction are treated as prior work, not new discoveries.

title: Rigidity of every shortest tensor-product torus design curve
